summary: Deletes a line item from a draft shipment.
description:
Deletes a line item from a draft shipment. Line items can only be deleted when the shipment is in Draft status (not locked).
The line item is marked as recycled (sets is_recycled = true).

parameters.name: shipment_id
parameters.description: The ID of the shipment containing the line item

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The GUID of the line item to delete
